blurb: Guests walk at their own pace through a 15-acre reptile zoo featuring over 800 alligators and more than 230 species including lizards, snakes, turtles, birds, and mammals. The park is mainly outdoors with some buildings like the Gift Shop and Serpentarium. Live daily shows include alligator feedings, handling lectures, and snake handling.
extraNote: No reservations needed; tickets sold only at the park · Guests cannot leave and re-enter the park during visit due to CDC guidelines · At the park entrance at Hwy 17 at Barefoot Landing, North Myrtle Beach, SC
